lead: An example or attack that ends on the CPU limit cannot narrow `cpu_time` with `Core\Config::set`.
body: The set answers `true` and `get` reads the new value back, but the watchdog charges the ceiling published when the request started, so the loop runs on and the sweep hangs until its timeout. End such a proof on `limits.memory` instead, which `Core\Config::set('limits.memory', '16M')` does enforce at once, or put `cpu_time` in a `--FILE nvs.toml--` section of a `.nvst` case.
